reviews.text: After purchasing the larger variant (using it on the Supernote Manta), and liking it so much, I decided to purchase a Remarkable Paper Pro Move and this planner specifically for it. I used to use the Move when it first released, but sold it shortly after. Now I know this planner is the thing I was missing to make the Move fit my workflow. Thanks to the seller/designer!

I use this constantly on the Supernote Manta. It looks great and is pretty responsive for the size and device. I had a nice conversation with the developer/seller, and they helped me out even though they didn't need to.

I bought the Premium Daily Planner for my reMarkable Paper Pro and Paper Move (I bought the Move specifically because of this template being available for it).   This might sound a bit odd, but the Premium Daily Planner templates make the reMarkable tablets what they should be.  

Perhaps I'm simple, but I've used the basic templates available since V1.  I've never looked at a template and thought "Yeah, that would make my daily use better."   

But, what a quality of life upgrade!  It has changed my day to day, quite a bit.  It fits my daily flow so well.   One click for the next day.  Notes, meetings, to-dos are just a click away.  

Many thanks to Thomas, well done!..   Great templates and great service.

Amazing customer support, fast response, and productive, customizable features that really set this company apart from their competition.  This organizer perfectly supports my personal and professional needs and has helped me stay on track.  I strongly recommend and am very happy with my purchase, thank you Thomas!

I'm scared because I'm afraid they'll suddenly stop making these someday. Tried all types of planners and productivity app and nothing has stuck until I found this one. The navigation is so intuitive this even beats all the apps I could get on my phone or laptop.

Absolutely phenomenal product and customer service!

I have purchased a number of Remarkable  templates from various Etsy vendors, but this shop and the associated planner absolutely went above and beyond my expectations.

1. The customized Daynichi planner provides so much functionality. I especially love how easy it is to navigate to all of the sections of the planner, no matter where I am within the document. It is by far the most well designed template I have used for the Remarkable Paper Pro Move. 

2. I have to rave about the customer service. Every question I had was answered in less than 24 hours, and all requests to modify the planner to suit my specific needs were graciously accommodated and delivered quickly.

I recommend this shop wholeheartedly and will certainly make additional purchases in the future!
